name: Kisanta
source:
He's always thinking wholeheartedly about the protagonist, a bright and lively person.
He's a childhood friend of the protagonist and usually fondly calls her Shana. But in order to clearly keep up their appearance of being master and servant in front of other people he calls her Yoshitsune-sama.
He dislikes grown men, and has a strange dislike of standing behind them.
